testedSource.basis: Canonical LF for text; exact binary assets. Source identity is not semantic parity.

tests.skipExplanation: Offscreen WebView case has a passing Windows native_transcript_tabs_real counterpart.

coveredChanges: Duplicate ACP question wrappers are hidden using the pinned source predicate while canonical tool records and explicit approval cards remain intact.

External captured attachments use durable owner-scoped byte copies, native leases and per-protocol descriptors; removed/pre-summary references stay outside canonical replay, and deleted-chat cleanup includes both attachment and fallback stores.

Canonical history continuity validates only the preceding completed owned harness binding; provider switches, destructive history changes and interrupted legacy turns create fresh sessions with bounded replay.

OpenCode keeps pending decisions and late command output after the first prompt response; denied tools continue through a bounded source-derived instruction without automatically retrying the denied operation.
Utility model resolution follows task-specific source ordering, supports HTTP utilities for coding-agent presets, and preserves exact provider instance selection for equal display labels.
Claude retries once only for an exact owned missing-session result before output/tool activity, preserving the original turn, workspace identity and active-time deadline.

liveValidation.scope: Actual Windows ADE composer and file picker, real CLI tools, close/restart of the same isolated profile. No auth UI or credential extraction.

limits: All701 feature rows and17331 indexed source function bodies remain preserved. Full semantic, line-by-line and identical model-reasoning parity is not established.
Direct Claude/Codex question-MCP configuration and source-specialized native question transcript rendering remain separate private work until integrated and tested.

Claude missing-session recovery is tested against documented typed envelopes and the installed diagnostic literal; the installed live missing-session envelope and paid Claude inference remain unobserved.
Continuity bindings do not prove an external CLI session was never advanced elsewhere if an older historical snapshot is restored into an entirely new Engine.

External attachment tests establish original-byte delivery and lifetime against native fixture processes; real CLI read permission may still ask or deny, and inline images retain native encoding/capability limits.

An unavailable captured file still referenced after the latest summary can block a fresh external turn; graceful historical omission remains a separate follow-up. Snapshot read failure may fall back to the original only when the captured SHA256 still matches.
Uncommitted fork rollback reports cleanup failure but does not add a new SessionStore retry transaction after a concurrent revision conflict.
Custom model CRUD/options, advanced account/usage paths, historical browser environment snapshots and other source-ledger gaps remain.
A long selected model label can scroll out its beginning while idle; a separate native selector repair is in progress.
